notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Long time no see, I am back to bring some [i]spooky[/i] news :)[/h1]

[b]Scream Steam is the perfect time for a halloween update and since this is a horror game we would need some new scary stuff in the game including:[/b]

-New sprites for Tinky standing in the hallway and crawling in the vent!

-New random ambient sounds!

-New eastereggs ;)


[h1]Two new items that can be found:[/h1]
[i]The Spooky Desk![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43533464/6de2e47c3bd6f7fdf189a94f3d539ba6ba3f0902.png[/img]



[i]Jacky The Pumpkin![/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43533464/c1c52ae55b31ac24ec4add43de42df15b4c47424.png[/img]





[h1]Small changes/Bug Fixes:[/h1]
-Fixed a bug that stucks the player in a blackscreen at the start.

-Fixed a bug that people could not struggle in the 3. minigame

-Decreased the minigame 3 struggle time

-Hopefully fixed the framerate capping



FNAT is now 15% off on the Scream Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2288310/Five_Nights_at_Tinkys/


This is the end, I wish you all a spooky and SCARY Halloween!!!
-Tinky

notes.title: Big Update! Difficulty Settings, New Achivements, Bug Fixes, New Desks and More
notes.notes:
[h1]FIVE NIGHTS AT TINKY'S BIG UPDATE![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43533464/a4ee7cb8731d4decfccbaa9f097a599ef00cf371.png[/img]


[h1]What's new?[/h1]

[b]Difficulty Settings and small changes with the monsters levels![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43533464/01bb81f312593610960e77c180b7e86c44cc471e.png[/img]



[b]6 New Achivements for each Night you beat in Normal or Hard difficulty![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43533464/a032792577ba9c90256ecb7298957a190e737c37.png[/img]



[b]Added 5 new Desks to find and to customize your office with![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43533464/7a273dfe2dbb73d34db6e0cb6902926791c7d65d.png[/img]



[b]Added something new after beating Night 6.[/b]



[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

[b]Fixed a bug that lets you start multiple fixes, wasting your power for no reason.

Fixed a bug that prevent the player from obtaining the "Purrfect Job" Achivement.

Fixed a bug that spammed the Smily Dialogue after being catched in Night 3.

Fixed a sound issue in the main menu.

Fixed some blurry sprites from some skins.[/b]

[i]
Keybinds and controller support coming soon![/i]

[i]Thank you for reading![/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2288310/Five_Nights_at_Tinkys/

notes.title: FNAT Release and Milestone
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43533464/a4ee7cb8731d4decfccbaa9f097a599ef00cf371.png[/img]
[b]FNAT has received alot of new content and updates since it got announced, including:[/b]
-post processing
-minigames/cutscenes after each night (3 from 6 done)
-reworks, nerfs/buffs
-new achivements
-new extra tab for the animatronics
-new deathscreen with tips for the player
-alot of bug fixes



[i](This list can change and could include more updates)[/i]
[b]FNAT will receive more content until the release, including:[/b]
-extra tab to replay all the minigames
-office customization
-unlockables for getting achivements or finishing nights
-custom night rework that lets you configure the power
-adding more mutators for endless night
